key_reasoning.reason: Shared _limit_results helper plus check_list_limit validator on three list tools (GetTestPlanTool, GetTestSuiteTool, GetTestCasesTool); validates model-supplied limit (-1 or >=1) at the tool-arg boundary. Default change 5 to 100 alters behavior but is a reversible config default. No exact precedent for the truncation-notice return shape (list vs dict).
Three tool classes, one base-class helper and the pydantic input/config models in the single azure_devops/test_plan package; pattern is clear.
